name: image-preview
description: Hover a pasted [Image #N] to see the picture: above the prompt while you write, and on the prompts you sent. (devflow-mods fork of midudev/better-claude@5abacf0)

window.title: Preview in a window
window.description: Where the terminal cannot draw the picture itself, show it in a small window of its own by the pointer, outside the terminal, at full quality (macOS, Windows, and Linux with X11 and Python's tkinter). Off, the terminal draws it in cells.

preferWindow.title: Window even where the terminal draws pictures
preferWindow.description: Use the window by the pointer even in terminals that draw the picture in cells themselves (Ghostty, kitty). herdr and cmux use it without this option, found by their HERDR_* and CMUX_* variables. Off by default. The window option must stay on.
